params.body:
The account page hid "Change plan" from team accounts, because they already have the top plan. A team member who signs in with their Observatory account then had no way from their account to the plans.

Every account now gets the link. For a team account it reads **Compare the plans**; for the others it stays **Change plan**.

Tests: 366 passing.
params.title: Account: a team account can compare the plans too
